mcp.instructions: Write-only OneDrive tools. get_item fetches metadata (eTag, cTag, size, folder/file, web URL) for a drive-relative path or item ID - it is a pre-write safety check, not a browsing tool; a not-found target surfaces as an error, not a negative answer. create_folder implements mkdir -p: it walks the path from the drive root, creating each missing segment, and is idempotent - an already-existing path succeeds with no changes. create_file creates a new file with inline text content; conflict_behavior defaults to 'fail' and also accepts 'rename' (appends a numeric suffix on collision) and 'replace' (overwrites). Parents are never auto-created by create_file - call create_folder first, or a typo'd path fails loudly rather than silently materializing a folder tree. This server may be running in dry-run mode, in which case every write tool validates and resolves but makes no actual change - its response is prefixed '[DRY RUN]' and states plainly that nothing was written or created. This server has no delete or update-in-place surface yet and no search tool - obtain paths/IDs from the Microsoft 365 connector's read/search tools, which share the same Graph ID space.
